high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post promoting "Instant Coffee Cubes" by Bevzilla. The post features a close-up photograph of a hand holding a cube of coffee, which is being added to a light green ceramic mug with a speckled pattern. The mug is placed on a wooden surface, and there are scattered coffee beans in the background, suggesting a cozy, coffee-related setting. The text overlay on the image highlights several key points: "NO NEED TO ADD SUGAR! IT HAS DATE PALM JAGGERY!" "IRON, CALCIUM, VITAMINS" "2
